faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Patna (NIT Patna) for a project-based research position in the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the ANRF/SERB sponsored research project titled with advertisement number ANRF/ECRG/2024/003781/ENS.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this NIT Patna recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment notification released by NIT Patna.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree (M.Tech/MSc/MS) in Electronics and Communication Engineering or VLSI discipline with at least 55% marks, or a B.Tech. degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to the JRF position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, OBC, PH, and female candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered for this JRF role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month along with an 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications via email and speed post is 15-10-2026. Applicants must ensure their documents reach well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is primarily through email to [email protected], followed by sending hard copies via speed post to the designated project investigator at NIT Patna.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NIT Patna JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting candidates based on their submitted applications and qualifications, followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application form (Annexure I) along with self-attested documents should be sent to Dr. Akash Agarwal, Project Investigator, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, NIT Patna, Bihta Campus, Patna - 801103, Bihar.
